_README: Mined 2026-08-21 from zeldaret/tww at Z:/memRip/sources/tww (read-only) plus the ripped assets at out/rip/GZLE01. This file closes the LAST placed-actor gap in the enemy tables: every remaining name in out/rip/GZLE01/godot/stage_data.json whose d_stage.cpp l_objectName entry resolves to a profile with Group == fopAc_ENEMY_e and that no other ww_enemies_*.json covers. Computed gap (placed count): Oship 55, Fmastr2 37, pow 28, Oqw 22, Ss 14, Rdead2 8, Fmastr1 7, Daiocta 6, Fmaster 6, Ji1 3, big_pow 2, plus kuro_s 17 / kuro_t 27 (Morth - Group fopAc_ENV_e, but a real enemy). ALIASES, NOT MINED HERE: 'pow' is the same actor as the already-profiled 'PW' (d_a_pw.cpp, ww_enemies_boss_jalhalla_molgera.json), 'Oqw' is the same actor as 'Oq' (d_a_oq.cpp), and 'big_pow' is the same actor as 'Bpw'. They are NOT duplicated here on purpose - but note that gcrip/godot.py keys Game.enemies by the PLACED name, so 'pow' (28 placements), 'Oqw' (22) and 'big_pow' (2) currently find no profile at runtime and fall back to the Bokoblin DEFAULTS. Whoever owns those three files should add alias keys there rather than here. MERGE ORDER: godot.py:9990 merges data/ww_enemies_*.json with sorted() + dict.update(), so 'ww_enemies_rest.json' sorts AFTER every other ww_enemies_* file and its entries always win. Nothing in this file shares a key with another file, so that changes nothing today. Fmaster.notes: The ambush Floormaster: it starts in mode 2 UNDERFOOT, hidden as a shadow on the floor, and rises where Link is standing. HP 12. It carries NO attack collider at all (both Atp fields are 0 and nothing ever writes them) - its whole threat is the grab: it holds Link for 10 frames (mSinkTimer), sinks him into the floor, steals up to 3 items and throws him. damage is therefore recorded as 0, which is the decomp's real answer, not a missing value. attack_range 100 = the grab distance field_0x0DC; notice 800 = the outer search ring; lose 3000 = the default leash when the placement leaves home.angle.z at 0. Boomerang and Boko stick do NO damage but paralyse it for 100 frames (mode 0x13, mahi clip) - that is the intended opening. Ice arrow freezes for 120 frames, light arrow shrinks it, hookshot and grappling hook only stagger. gravity is 0.0 because the Floormaster never applies gravity to itself - it slides along the floor with cLib_addCalcPosXZ2 and the ypit00 hole model follows it. Each spawn rolls a random 1..10 speed multiplier (field_0x394), so run/walk here are the per-frame CAPS, not a fixed rate.
